Website free access is independent of paid venue membership.
Photos are licensed Wikimedia Commons files (CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA); author, licence and file page are stored per place. Places without a verified photo show a clearly labelled no-photo message.

Regional sample entries cover all six Thai regions outside the original Bangkok/nonthaburi focus; image links point to real Wikimedia Commons photographs with per-image attribution and licence. Remote photos require an internet connection.

Weekly and split schedules use sourced hours; candidate public/bank holiday dates on gym schedules remain unknown until that branch confirms its own holiday calendar. Dated seasonal closures override opening schedules.
